review_notes: I read the whole file and searched Mathlib for other uses of characterSpace and gelfandTransform. I also looked for competing algebra-homomorphism-to-scalars constructions, including ContinuousAlgHom in Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/Algebra.lean. characterSpace is a subset of WeakDual (nonzero multiplicative elements). It is not a generic type of algebra homomorphisms, and it carries the weak-* topology. Its toCLM, toNonUnitalAlgHom and toAlgHom are named views of that representation, and they are built on the existing FunLike and HomClass hierarchy. The only other Gelfand transform I found is gelfandStarTransform in GelfandDuality.lean. It is a star-equivalence built from this file's gelfandTransform, so it is a downstream wrapper and not an independent competitor. I found no case for consolidation. Some uncertainty remains because I did not search every Mathlib file for other structures of the same shape.
